description: List FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) team-event records with flexible filters. Each row represents one team's performance at one event (rank, record, EPA, awards). Filter any combination of `team` (one team across all events), `year`, `event` (all teams at one event - great for getting an event's full team list with stats), `country`, `state`, `district`, `type` (regional, district, district_cmp, champs_div, einstein, offseason), and `week` (0-8). Sort with `metric`/`ascending` and paginate with `limit`/`offset`. Use this to answer "show every event team 254 has attended in 2024", "list all teams at 2024flor with their ranks", or "rank teams by EPA across all 2024 district championships".

ascending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order. Default is ascending.

country.description: Capitalized country name, e.g. USA or Canada.

district.description: District abbreviation. One of: ca, fch, fim, fin, fit, fma, fnc, fsc, isr, ne, ont, pch, pnw, win.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). Default is 1000.

metric.description: How to sort the returned values. Any column in the table is valid.

offset.description: Offset from the first result to return.

state.description: Capitalized two-letter state code, e.g. NC.

type.description: One of: regional, district, district_cmp, champs_div, einstein, or offseason.

week.description: Week of the competition season. 8 is CMP.

name: get_team_events
